name: ChatGPT

lifecycle.note: Launched as a free research preview; OpenAI publishes no retirement date for the original November 2022 model, which had no API id, and the ChatGPT product has since moved to other models.

released.note: Released as a free research preview.

relations.note: OpenAI says ChatGPT is fine-tuned from a model in the GPT-3.5 series, using RLHF with the same methods as InstructGPT.

summary.text: ChatGPT is a conversational language model from OpenAI, fine-tuned from a model in the GPT-3.5 series and offered from 30 November 2022 as a free research preview. OpenAI calls it a sibling model to InstructGPT and says it can answer follow-up questions, admit its mistakes, challenge incorrect premises and reject inappropriate requests.

changes.text: Trained for dialogue: human trainers wrote conversations playing both user and assistant, mixed with the InstructGPT dataset converted to dialogue format.
Offered as a free research preview on the web instead of through the API.
OpenAI says lessons from deploying GPT-3 and Codex informed its safety mitigations, including reductions in harmful and untruthful outputs through RLHF.

access.note: Free web research preview at launch.

notes: The record is the model OpenAI introduced on 2022-11-30, not the ChatGPT product as a whole; the alias ChatGPT is set to never because the product name covers many later models. OpenAI calls it a sibling model to InstructGPT. Prominence milestone is editorial: it opens the ChatGPT model line.
